units.source_text: 且说源氏公子入宫参见，桐壶上皇看见了他便说：

en.t: Now Prince Genji entered the palace to pay his respects, and when the Retired Emperor Kiritsubo saw him, he said:
You have grown much thinner lately!
I suppose it is because you have been eating vegetarian fare for so long?

units.source_text: 很怜惜他，便在御前赐膳。

en.t: Taking great pity on him, he had a meal served to him in the imperial presence.

units.source_text: 又问他种种情况，关怀无微不至。

en.t: He also asked about all manner of things concerning him, showing care in every possible detail.

units.source_text: 情爱之深挚，使源氏公子铭感五中。

en.t: The depth and sincerity of that affection moved Prince Genji to the very core.

units.source_text: 告退之后，又去藤壶院参谒母后。

en.t: After taking his leave, he went on to the Fujitsubo residence to pay his respects to the Empress Mother.

units.source_text: 宫女们久不见源氏公子，个个兴奋，都来慰问。

en.t: The ladies of the court had not seen Prince Genji for a long time, and each of them came forward excitedly to offer words of comfort.

units.source_text: 藤壶皇后命王命妇传言：“公子近遭大厄，深为同情！

en.t: Empress Fujitsubo instructed Omyobu to convey this message: Prince, you have recently suffered a great misfortune, and I feel deeply for you.

units.source_text: 日月推迁，不知哀思稍减否？”

en.t: As the days and months have passed, I wonder whether your grief has eased even a little?

units.source_text: 源氏公子答道：“固知人生无常，乃世间不易之理，

en.t: Prince Genji replied: I know well that human life is impermanent, and that this is an unchanging truth of the world,

units.source_text: 但躬逢其事，痛苦实多，不免心情缭乱。

en.t: but when one meets it in one's own life, the suffering is truly great, and the heart cannot help but be thrown into confusion.

units.source_text: 幸蒙母后屡次存问，衷心感慰，因得延命至今。”

en.t: Fortunately, Your Majesty has repeatedly asked after me, and I have been comforted from the heart; because of that, I have been able to go on living until now.

units.source_text: 即使是平日，源氏公子访问藤壶皇后时亦必满怀愁绪，

en.t: Even in ordinary times, whenever Prince Genji visited Empress Fujitsubo, his heart was always filled with sorrow,

units.source_text: 何况此时添了鼓盆之恸，自然悲伤更甚。

en.t: and now that the grief of losing his wife had been added to it, his sadness was naturally even deeper.

units.source_text: 他身穿无纹大礼服，内衬淡墨色衬袍，冠缨卷起。

en.t: He wore a plain formal robe without pattern, with a pale ink-colored underrobe beneath it, and the cords of his court cap were rolled up.

units.source_text: 这样朴素打扮，反比华丽装束饶有风韵。

en.t: This simple attire had, if anything, more grace and charm than splendid dress.

units.source_text: 他久不见东宫太子，便探询近况，表示怀念。

en.t: Since he had not seen the Crown Prince for a long time, he asked about his recent condition and expressed how much he missed him.

units.source_text: 又谈了许多话，直到夜深方才告退，回二条院去。

en.t: They spoke of many more things, and only when the night had grown late did he finally take his leave and return to Nijo-in.
